Package org.a2aproject.sdk.compat03.spec

Class JSONParseError_v0_3

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Error
org.a2aproject.sdk.compat03.spec.JSONRPCError_v0_3
org.a2aproject.sdk.compat03.spec.JSONParseError_v0_3
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, A2AError_v0_3, Event_v0_3
public class JSONParseError_v0_3 extends JSONRPCError_v0_3 implements A2AError_v0_3
JSON-RPC error indicating that the server received invalid JSON that could not be parsed.

This error is returned when the request payload is not valid JSON, such as malformed syntax, unexpected tokens, or encoding issues. This is distinct from InvalidRequestError_v0_3, which indicates structurally valid JSON that doesn't conform to the JSON-RPC specification.

Corresponds to JSON-RPC 2.0 error code -32700.

Usage example: 


 try {
     objectMapper.readValue(payload, JSONRPCRequest.class);
 } catch (org.a2aproject.sdk.compat03.json.JsonProcessingException e) {
     throw new JSONParseError("Malformed JSON: " + e.getMessage());
 }
